known.title: Preserve the money formatter used by API generation
Update the kind-table tests after removing web settings

findings.body:
chunk 1/4:

Removing `csv` breaks every TypeScript feature containing a money field. `src/forge/feature_api.py:399` still reads `kinds["kinds"][kind]["csv"]` while rendering the controller, so a command such as `forge task feature invoices --one invoice --field 'name:text' --field 'total:money'` raises `KeyError: 'csv'` before writing the feature. Keep this API export setting when removing the web settings.
findings.title: Preserve the money formatter used by API generation

findings.body:
chunk 1/4:

`tests/test_database_kinds.py:74–75` still indexes `money["input"]` and `money["cell"]`. Both settings are removed here, so both parameters of `test_5_feature_columns_come_from_the_kind_table` fail in `_assert_kind_values`, before generating or exercising a feature. This independently breaks the TypeScript and Python smoke selections even after restoring the API's `csv` setting. Remove the obsolete web assertions while retaining the API and database checks.
